scenes.title: Шесть сорок пять
scenes.summary: At dawn Graham draws Hannah a street map to the old hardware shop across the bridge before guests wake up.

scenes.title: Синяя дверь
scenes.summary: Across the river Hannah calls Graham from the square to check the last turn and finds the right brass valve.

scenes.title: Горячие булочки с корицей
scenes.summary: Downstairs Tessa and Arthur tempt early-rising Evelyn with fresh cinnamon rolls before anyone turns on a cold tap.

scenes.title: Внизу в котельной
scenes.summary: In the cellar Graham and Hannah swap in the new brass valve and bring hot water roaring back through the house.

scenes.title: Пятизвёздочный душ
scenes.summary: Caleb praises the hot shower at breakfast while flustered Arthur accidentally hints that they read his notebook.

scenes.title: Архитектор-акустик
scenes.summary: Under the courtyard tree, Caleb shows Hannah and Tessa his sketches: he studies quiet courtyard acoustics, not hotel stars.

scenes.title: Солнечный свет на бирке
scenes.summary: While airing out the luggage closet, Graham brings out the blue suitcase and Evelyn recognizes the old address in daylight.

scenes.title: Мальчик на ступеньках
scenes.summary: In the courtyard Evelyn describes the quiet younger brother listening from the stairs just as Caleb walks out and hears her.
